scenarios.title: Tutorial: Solo Weekend 3D
scenarios.background: I am planning a simple solo movie outing for the weekend, but it only works if I can find a 3D showing of Cosmic Laughs with a centered seat at a theater that is still close enough.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. I would like to see Cosmic Laughs alone this weekend, on Saturday, March 14 or Sunday, March 15 (Monday and Tuesday do not work). I prefer the closest theater, but anything within 10 miles is fine. It must be a 3D showing, and I need it to end before 7:00 PM. For 3D, the seat should be reasonably centered — not a side seat.

stepBriefs.theater: I prefer the closest theater, but any within 10 miles works.
stepBriefs.date: I can only go on Saturday, March 14 or Sunday, March 15.
stepBriefs.time: I need a 3D showing that ends before 7:00 PM.
stepBriefs.seat: I need a reasonably centered seat, not a side one.

scenarios.title: S1-T1: Child Playdate Family Movie (Easy)
scenarios.background: I am trying to turn the end of my child's Sunday playdate into an easy movie outing for the kids, without a long wait before the movie starts.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. My child has a playdate this Sunday, March 15, wrapping up around 11:00 AM, and I promised the kids a movie right after. The movie must be rated G or PG for elementary-school kids, and shorter is better so they can sit through it. I would start with the closer theater. I prefer the earliest showtime after 11:00 AM. We need three seats together, not in the very front rows.

stepBriefs.movie: I need a G or PG rated kid-friendly movie, preferably the shorter one.
stepBriefs.theater: I would start with the closer theater.
stepBriefs.date: I need it on Sunday, March 15.
stepBriefs.time: I need the earliest showtime after 11:00 AM.
stepBriefs.seat: I need three adjacent seats, not in the front rows.

scenarios.title: S1-T2: Friends Action Night (Hard)
scenarios.background: I am planning a Saturday-night action movie with my friend, and I want it to feel like a real night out instead of something rushed into a bad slot with bad seats.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. A friend and I want an action movie this Saturday night, March 14. The showing has to be IMAX — a standard screening would not feel like a real night out. I would start with the closest theater, but could switch for noticeably better amenities. I cannot arrive before 5:30 PM, and I need the movie to end by 10:30 PM. If a few action movies fit, I would go with the highest-rated one. We need two seats together, not in the front rows.

stepBriefs.movie: I need an action movie, preferably the highest-rated one.
stepBriefs.theater: I would start with the closer theater, but could switch for better timing.
stepBriefs.date: I can only do Saturday, March 14.
stepBriefs.time: I need an IMAX showing (not standard) that starts after 5:30 PM and ends by 10:30 PM.
stepBriefs.seat: I need two adjacent seats, not in the front rows.

scenarios.title: S2-T1: Solo Weekend SF Outing (Easy)
scenarios.background: I am planning a simple solo movie outing for the weekend, but it only works if the closest theater is actually showing the one sci-fi movie I want.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. I need to see Starfall Circuit by myself this weekend — Saturday, March 14 or Sunday, March 15. I would start with the closest theater, but it needs free parking since I am driving. If more than one theater works, I prefer something moderately sized over a giant multiplex. The movie needs to end by 7:00 PM so it does not collide with my evening plans.

stepBriefs.theater: I prefer the closest theater with free parking, and would rather avoid a huge multiplex.
stepBriefs.date: I need it this weekend, Saturday, March 14 or Sunday, March 15, and I would prefer Saturday.
stepBriefs.time: I need the showtime to end by 7:00 PM.
stepBriefs.seat: I am fine with any normal available seat.

scenarios.title: S2-T2: Parents Anniversary Gift (Hard)
scenarios.background: I am trying to set up a movie outing for my parents anniversary weekend, and I want it to feel warm, comfortable, and a little special.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. I am booking a movie for my parents' anniversary weekend. Saturday, March 14 is closer to the actual anniversary, but Sunday, March 15 is also available. It must be a romance movie, PG-13 or below, with a warm and familiar tone. On Saturday it needs to start after 4:00 PM and end by 9:00 PM. On Sunday it must be a true morning showing — my parents like to head home early, so a matinee or evening would not work. The seats must be premium — standard would feel too ordinary for an anniversary gift. I will start at the closest theater but can switch for better timing or seating.

stepBriefs.movie: I need a PG-13 or below romance movie, preferably warm and familiar in tone.
stepBriefs.theater: I would start with the closer theater, but can switch for better timing or seating.
stepBriefs.date: I prefer Saturday, March 14, but Sunday, March 15 also works.
stepBriefs.time: I need it to start after 4:00 PM and end by 9:00 PM on Saturday, and on Sunday I need a true morning show.
stepBriefs.seat: I need two adjacent premium seats — standard would feel too ordinary.

scenarios.title: S3-T1: Couple Date Small Theater (Easy)
scenarios.background: I am planning a weekend mystery-movie date with my partner, and I want it to feel comfortable from the start, so the theater choice matters right away.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. My partner and I want a weekend movie date — Saturday, March 14 or Sunday, March 15, preferring Saturday. It has to be a mystery, and I would pick the better-reviewed one. The theater must have reclining seats for comfort. On Saturday the movie needs to start after 7:00 PM and end by 10:00 PM. On Sunday it needs to end by 6:00 PM. A comfortable pair of seats together would be nice.

stepBriefs.movie: I need a mystery movie, preferably the higher-rated one.
stepBriefs.theater: I need a theater with reclining seats.
stepBriefs.date: I need it on Saturday, March 14 or Sunday, March 15, and I would prefer Saturday.
stepBriefs.time: I need it to start after 7:00 PM and end by 10:00 PM on Saturday, and on Sunday it needs to end by 6:00 PM.
stepBriefs.seat: I would like a comfortable pair of seats together.

scenarios.title: S3-T2: Sibling B-Movie Comedy Night (Hard)
scenarios.background: I am planning a movie night with my sibling, and I want it to feel weird and fun in exactly the right low-budget way, even if I have to try a couple of paths first.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. My sibling and I can go on Friday, March 13 or Saturday, March 14 — Friday preferred. We want something weird and fun: a rough B-movie or cult comedy, the scrappier lower-rated pick over anything polished. It has to be at the single-screen theater — a giant multiplex would kill the vibe. The movie needs to start after 6:00 PM and end by 10:00 PM, and I prefer the earlier showtime. We need two seats together, not in the back rows.

stepBriefs.movie: I want a cult comedy, and I prefer the lower-rated one over the higher-rated one.
stepBriefs.theater: I need it at the single-screen theater.
stepBriefs.date: I can go on Friday, March 13 or Saturday, March 14, and I prefer Friday.
stepBriefs.time: I need it starting after 6:00 PM and ending by 10:00 PM, preferring the earlier showtime.
stepBriefs.seat: I need two adjacent seats, not in the back rows.

scenarios.title: S4-T1: Family Amenity Showtime Choice (Easy)
scenarios.background: I am planning a family movie outing for Sunday, and I want it to stay simple from the moment we arrive, so the theater setup matters right away.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. I want to take the family to a movie on Sunday, March 15. The theater needs both free parking and a family lounge. I want a light family movie — the shorter one if there are options. The movie needs to end before 2:00 PM. We need four seats together. If the first showtime does not have a good block, I can try another at the same theater.

stepBriefs.movie: I need a light family movie, preferably the shorter one.
stepBriefs.theater: I need a theater with both free parking and a family lounge.
stepBriefs.date: I need it on Sunday, March 15.
stepBriefs.time: I need the earliest showtime that ends before 2:00 PM.

scenarios.title: S4-T2: Last Movie Before Trip (Hard)
scenarios.background: I am trying to fit in one last movie night with a friend before the trip, and I want it to feel easy and worth doing even if my first movie choice falls through.
scenarios.story: Today is Wednesday, March 11, 2026. I want one last movie night with a friend before a trip — it has to be Friday, March 13. The theater needs reserved seating and free parking. It has to be a comedy, preferably the more mature R-rated one. The showing must be standard format — no IMAX or 3D. It needs to start after 4:00 PM and end by 10:00 PM. If my first movie falls through, I can try another. We need two adjacent center seats.

stepBriefs.movie: I need a comedy, preferably the more mature R-rated one.
stepBriefs.theater: I need a theater with reserved seating and free parking.
stepBriefs.date: I need it on Friday, March 13.
stepBriefs.time: I need a standard-format showing (no IMAX/3D) starting after 4:00 PM and ending by 10:00 PM, preferring earlier.
stepBriefs.seat: I need two adjacent seats, and both must be center seats in the 3–6 range.

scenarios.title: Demo: Open Booking (Bring Your Own Preferences)
scenarios.background: There is no script. Book whatever film you would actually want to see in Detroit this week, however you would want to see it.
scenarios.story: Today is Tuesday, November 3, 2026, and you are at the UIST demo reception at the Renaissance Center in Detroit. Five films are playing across five real cinemas between now and Sunday, November 8. Ask for whatever you actually want — a genre, a title, a night, a cinema you can get to, a format, seats together.

stepBriefs.movie: Whatever you feel like seeing. Five films are playing.
stepBriefs.theater: Whichever cinema suits you, 2.5 to 20 miles out.
stepBriefs.date: Any day from today, Tuesday November 3, through Sunday November 8.
stepBriefs.time: Any showtime. Standard, 3D and IMAX all run.
stepBriefs.seat: Any seats — together, up front, premium.

scenarios.title: Demo A: Tonight, After the Reception
scenarios.background: The reception is over and there is still an evening left. One ticket, close to downtown, back before midnight.
scenarios.story: Today is Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The UIST demo reception wraps up around 7:30 PM and I want to see Klara and the Sun tonight. I would rather not drive far — under 15 miles if I can help it, and the closest option is best. The showing has to start after 8:00 PM, and I want to be back downtown before midnight. One seat, somewhere near the middle, and not in the front two rows.

stepBriefs.movie: I want Klara and the Sun specifically.
stepBriefs.theater: The closest theater, and no more than 15 miles out.
stepBriefs.time: It has to start after 8:00 PM and be over before midnight.
stepBriefs.seat: One seat near the middle, not in the front two rows.

scenarios.title: Demo B: IMAX Night With a Co-author
scenarios.background: A proper last night out with a co-author — but the only IMAX in the region is further away than I said I would drive.
scenarios.story: Today is Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A co-author and I want to see Street Fighter on Thursday, November 5 — the last night of the conference. It has to be IMAX; a standard screening is not worth the trip. I am not willing to drive more than 15 miles from the Renaissance Center. The showing needs to start after 6:30 PM and end by 11:00 PM. We need two seats together, and not in the front rows.

stepBriefs.theater: Nothing more than 15 miles from the Renaissance Center, closest first.
stepBriefs.date: Thursday, November 5, the last night of the conference.
stepBriefs.time: IMAX only, starting after 6:30 PM and ending by 11:00 PM.
stepBriefs.seat: Two seats together, not in the front rows.

scenarios.title: Demo C: Family Matinee Before the Flight
scenarios.background: Two kids, a closing session that runs to lunchtime, and an evening flight out of Detroit.
scenarios.story: Today is Tuesday, November 3, 2026. On Thursday, November 5 I am taking a colleague's two kids to a movie after the closing session. It has to be rated PG or below, and the shorter one is better so they sit through it. We need to be out by 5:00 PM to make an evening flight. Three seats together, not in the front rows. I would start with the closest theater but can go further for a better showtime.

stepBriefs.movie: A PG-or-below family movie, and the shorter one if there is a choice.
stepBriefs.theater: Start with the closest theater, but I can go further for a better showtime.
stepBriefs.seat: Three seats together, not in the front rows.
